dex.text: Armoured like a tiny knight and given antlers as an afterthought. Spends most of its life in the dark, letting the rotting wood do the hard work.
dex.fact: Stag beetles are Britain's largest beetle, and their larvae live in rotting wood for several years before they emerge.

dex.text: Jaws like a pair of pliers and the confidence of something that has been eating rotten wood for years. Charges along the hedgerow as if it owns the lane.
dex.fact: Male stag beetles use their huge jaws to wrestle rivals, and the females have much smaller jaws.
